{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species and print only the values
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print only the mean values (to avoid including unprinted values in evidence)
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract and print the highest mean species and value
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'\nHighest mean species: {highest_mean_species}')
print(f'Highest mean value: {highest_mean_value:.2f} mm')"}
